title: To set aside a decree passed _ex
text:
123. To set aside a decree passed _ex_

_parte or to rehear an appeal_
decreed or heard ex parte.

_Explanation.—For the purpose of_

this article, substituted service
under rule 20 of Order V of
the Code of Civil Procedure,
1908 (5 of 1908) shall not be
deemed to be due service.
